interpretation: Clones of one living community share genotypes, bodies, ages, energy, positions, food, fields, and random states. Mutation is disabled. Only the specified acquired state and hidden food quality are changed; spontaneous reversals are held until after the window. Erasure can disrupt ordinary dynamics. A performance change shows dependence on state, not by itself adaptive learning or generalization. These branches are paired interventions, not independent evolutionary replicates.
